title: Podcast episode edit review
summary: [00:00-00:44] Rough-cut review — Participant B opens the rough-cut review of a community-history episode and asks how to present the guest’s correction of the station opening year from 1984 to 1986 • [00:44-01:20] Correction options — Participant A will prepare two short versions so Participant B can choose the clearer approach before the next full edit • [01:20-01:52] Historical accuracy — Participant B wants the correction to be apparent without suggesting that the historical date has been independently verified • [01:52-02:34] Music & show notes — Participant C raises music licensing and the accuracy of an archive link in the show notes, and will check the music and notes and suggest alternative titles • [02:34-03:08] Transcript alignment — Participant D discusses speaker labels in the episode transcript and will align the text with the revised audio • [03:08-03:39] Release timing — Participant B says a Friday release remains possible, but the publication date depends on finishing the checks and edits
